review.tagline: Independent Claude API starter projects, one folder per pattern
review.summary: Independent Claude API starter projects in one repo, not one app: a customer support agent with a knowledge base, a financial data analyst with charts, computer-use and Playwright browser-use demos, a two-agent coding loop on the Agent SDK, and Managed Agents examples for Slack, Linear, Sentry, MCP and CopilotKit AG-UI. Mixed Next.js and Python, each folder with its own setup. For developers copying out one pattern.
review.audience: Developers copying one Claude pattern into their own app
strengths: Covers computer use, browser use, Agent SDK and Managed Agents in one checkout
Each quickstart is self-contained with its own README and setup
Ships a CLAUDE.md for agent-driven edits
weaknesses: Not a single forkable app; you extract one subfolder
No auth, billing or database at the root; only what each sample needs
